resources.string: Unencrypted (http): anyone on the same network can read and change what is sent. Only safe in your own network - on another Wi-Fi with the same addresses, someone else may answer.
Uses the system recognizer. Which languages are available offline is up to the system settings.
This phone has no on-device recognizer: the system one may send your voice to its servers, and such dictations are marked as cloud. Parakeet or Whisper stay on the phone.
The languages you dictate in. With several, Whisper detects per dictation which one was spoken. A single one is forced: anything said in another language is then translated.
Anything with /v1/audio/transcriptions - Speaches, LocalAI, whisper.cpp\'s server.
With or without /v1. http:// only for servers in your own network. An Amber PC address with its key in it is split into address and key.
Stored encrypted on this phone only.
Which of %1$s\'s models turns your voice into text.
%1$s offers no speech model right now.

The languages you dictate in. Several: %1$s picks among them for each dictation; a very short one can still land in the wrong one and come out translated. A single one is forced: anything said in another language is then translated.
None picked: %1$s guesses among all languages.
Automatic works for most. One fixed language helps with short dictations.
Cleanup models of this server are picked under Settings → Cleanup, for any speech recognition.
ElevenLabs Realtime was never finished. Remove this speech recognition.
A test is billed like a dictation ($%1$s).
Its settings and stored key are deleted. Downloaded models stay until you delete them.
Bigger means more accurate but slower. Download, then \"Use\".
A whisper.cpp model you picked yourself. Runs with the full context.
Already downloaded from FUTO? Pick the .bin file, it is recognized and checked.
A one-time download; Wi-Fi recommended. While you dictate it holds about 700 MB of memory, freed again after three idle minutes.
None picked: Whisper guesses among all languages.
Recordings only go to a verified enclave, over a connection bound to its verified key. Otherwise nothing is sent.
This key was entered for %1$s. It is not sent to this address - enter it again to use it here.
